title: Have electrical work done only by licensed electricians
what: Have electrical work carried out only by people whose licence or permit authorises it.

sources.title: Electricity (Licensing) Regulations 1991 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Subject to this regulation, a person who carries out any electrical work commits an offence unless the carrying out of that work by that person is authorised by a licence or permit
